Bid Award Panel grant authority to award the contract in accordance with the Contract Details set out in the report (February 13, 2025) from the Chief Procurement Officer: Solicitation Number: Request for Proposal Doc4879606963 Description: For the feasibility study to re-imagine the City of Toronto's Civic Centre public spaces, for Corporate Real Estate Management (CREM). The term of the agreement is to be for a period of one (1) year from date of award, with an option in favour of the City to extend the agreement on the same terms and conditions for an additional term of up to one (1) year. Should the option be exercised, then the Executive Director, CREM will request the Chief Procurement Officer to process the renewal under the same terms and conditions, with no increase in the contract value.
